candidates.name: SCOPED_LOCAL_GRANT
candidates.definition: Block only the reserved transmitter, receiver, and one-hop local interference neighbours; non-conflicting remote links remain eligible.

candidates.name: FINAL_HACK_RELEASE_PIGGYBACK
candidates.definition: The final H_ACK carries a release flag; explicit RELEASE and lease timeout remain fallbacks when the acknowledgement is absent or incomplete.

candidates.name: BOUNDED_RESERVATION_REUSE_2
candidates.definition: A successful grant can serve at most two FIFO packets of the same flow and segment, subject to an unexpired grant, no conflict/NACK, and no higher-priority waiter.
